upstream.adapter_time_binding: Tesseract OCR reads every fixed-layout UTC footer; latest animation frame binds valid_time, and unrecognized timestamps fail closed

differences: The two live GIF endpoints remain distinct stations and explicitly reject historical queries.

The official TMD page labels displayed time as UTC. The GIF container and HTTP response omit observation-time metadata, so the adapter OCRs the rendered footer on every frame, requires the documented UTC time format and 15-minute sequence, and uses the last frame time as valid_time.

The retained and current live endpoint images visibly report April 2023 observations despite September 2026 retrieval. latest therefore reports the actual old observation time; max_age can reject it instead of treating retrieval time as freshness.

Timestamp OCR uses the system Tesseract executable and a pinned 680x680 footer crop. Missing OCR, layout changes, unreadable text, or invalid cadence fail closed; this is separate from radar-value decoding.
Display colors are preserved as raw data until palette and grid evidence exist.
